items.title: Mojo Programming Language is Now Open Source
items.why: This makes a high-performance language designed for AI development accessible to a broader engineering community, potentially accelerating AI innovation.

items.title: Meta Releases Muse Glimmer, a New Open-Source 30B Agentic Model
items.why: Engineers can now experiment with and build upon a new, permissively licensed open-source agentic LLM from Meta, broadening choices beyond existing models.

items.title: Sandboxing Untrusted Python & JavaScript with smolvm/smolmachines
items.why: This research offers robust solutions for securely executing untrusted code, critical for platforms allowing user-generated scripts or LLM-generated extensions.

items.title: Ramp Launches 'Router' for Managing Multiple AI Models via API
items.why: This tool provides a unified API to access and switch between various large language models, simplifying the architecture for AI application development.

items.title: JSON API for Programmatic Scraping Using Bun 1.4's WebView
items.why: Engineers can leverage Bun's new WebView feature to build efficient, programmatic web scraping and automation tools with a modern JavaScript runtime.
